rows.summary: Synthesize findings for emergent preference formation in multi-modal agents and continue investigation into path-dependent policy divergence.

rows.title: Reacting to Enforcement: Intelligent Disobedience Research

rows.summary: Following the inconclusive result of experiment test-113, which failed to reach the required variance threshold for detecting path-dependent divergence, this proposal revises the hypothesis to explore lower coupling parameters, thereby increasing state freedom. A new experiment (test-114) is defined to test this hypothesis. Commitments to divergent_values research are maintained.
